calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS ver_sub, p.category AS ver_cat, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
    AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
)
SELECT fiscal_week, ver_sub, ver_cat, channel_code, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl,
       sum(quantity) AS units, min(quantity) AS minq, max(quantity) AS maxq, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(net_amount) AS net
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.sale_date, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date,
         cp.subcategory AS sub, p.category AS cat
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-28' AND DATE '2026-08-03'
)
SELECT 'sales_sale_date_P3_int_paint' k, sum(quantity) v, count(*) n FROM sl WHERE sub='Interior Paint' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_helsinki_ts_P3_int_paint', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM sl WHERE sub='Interior Paint' AND hel_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_date_mismatch_rows', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM sl WHERE sale_date <> hel_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_products_P3_units_fact', sum(quantity), count(*) FROM sl WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cat<>'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'control_rpt_units_P3', sum(units_sold), count(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_int_paint_by_return_date_P3', sum(r.quantity_returned), count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL SELECT 'int_paint_sold_other_store_versions', count(*), count(DISTINCT s.store_key) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=108
UNION ALL SELECT 'lahti_days_with_sales', count(DISTINCT sale_date), 0 FROM sl WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT p.subcategory AS ver_sub, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, sum(f.quantity) units, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND (p.subcategory ILIKE '%paint%' OR cp.subcategory ILIKE '%paint%' OR p.subcategory ILIKE '%interior%')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
